author: Przemek Bądaruk (Przemekkkth)
description: Slide the tiles and merge equal numbers until you reach 2048. Swipe in any direction; keyboard: arrows. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: Slide the tiles and merge equal numbers until you reach 2048. Swipe in any direction; keyboard: arrows. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
